head_commit.message:
test(core): avoid Windows TCP/UDP reservation conflicts in loopback peers

Select Windows shared-port candidates outside read-only TCP and UDP exclusion tables, then hold both actual sockets. Preserve immediate permission errors, bounded collision retries and complete cleanup. Add six selector regressions and validate both families after a first collision.

Preserve the actual failed Windows DNS run and the exact R3 and Vision record-repair results. Local DNS 37, SS policy 16 and CI guard 41 all pass on the frozen fixture source. Full Rust, mature Xray, Windows Qt and App CI must execute on this new commit.

Retain concurrent font commits through d175d817 and the fixed 79-item, six-accepted, 10.83% baseline.
